decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extensions hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - No fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times 8am to 11.30pm.

Condition : 6 - Notwithstanding the information submitted with the application details of the workings of the fume extraction ducting shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details prior to the completion of the development.

Condition : 7 - Textured panels shall be incorporated into the entrance door and a kicking plate 400mm high shall be provided on the entrance door and permanently retained.  The textured panels should be no higher than 1000mm above ground level and should include a diagonal hand rail across the full width of the door with a diameter of 45-50mm.  The door shall have a minimum width of 900mm with a level threshold. These features shall be installed before the door is first used and permanently retained.
description: Erection of part single and part two storey rear extension, rear roof extension, installation of roof lights on the front roof slope, installation of fume extraction ducting, installation of windows in side wall, relocation of staircase and change of use of ground floor from A1 to A3 with new shop front.
